book.name: 1 Kolinita
book.title: 1 KOLINITA MeKolinita ꞌidi leta ꞌaigeda Paulo ꞌileleya

content: Cimi pui yahesagoheya weyahina ꞌaigeda loheya ꞌoimiyega tamana mwanena mahetena sipuiya. Pui beno gala hedada. Taudi tomiya ganamuli gogo baibaiwana ꞌoidiya geya gidemusa sida mumuga ꞌesa.
Sahena wanuwanuwahane, ma hesi mumuga bewa weyahina wadou, ma topuiina ꞌimi boda ꞌoinega wapaꞌi.
Bewa tuwa taugu yamiya bwagabwaga, ma hesi ꞌigu nuwatuhu ꞌoimiya ꞌimiyamiya, gidemusa taugu mahetemiu, ꞌoinega topuiina ꞌana loina ꞌoimiya yahepwaileyawa, beno ꞌida Bada Yesu saninega.
Cana loinaina bewa gidemusa, miya hegogona wapaihowa ꞌida Bada Yesu saninega, ta ꞌigu nuwatuhu wete mahetemiu ma Badaina Yesu ꞌina waiwaiyega.
Topuiina waꞌebwae Seitani ꞌoina ma ꞌabehega wahina ꞌiꞌabihegala ma ꞌoinega muliyetega ꞌida Bada ꞌina sabweloina ꞌoina loheyaina yaluyaluwana ꞌida ꞌabihete.
Ma sahena wanuwanuwahane, ma hesi wanuwatuhuyahi ꞌabehega ꞌeguma puiina muhemuhena ꞌoimiya ꞌimiyamiya nata mabwaiyami ꞌiꞌabihe galegomi.
Coinega puiina ꞌoimiyega wapaꞌi ma waheboda bwebweꞌana, weyahina Keliso ꞌina ꞌamasa ꞌoinega ꞌideuligemi ma Kelisoina tauna gidemusa ꞌida Hataona Guyaina baweina, tuwa weyahida siloheꞌamasiya.
Eeta ꞌida guyai tapaihowa, geya maꞌida ꞌedaꞌeda miyamiyana galana ꞌoinega, ta hesi ꞌedaꞌeda bwebweꞌana ma dumwadumwaluna ꞌoidiyega.
Mwalona ꞌimi leta ꞌaigeda ꞌoina yahepwaila ꞌabehega geyaꞌabwa topuiyedi mahetemiyao waꞌahwa ꞌiyaꞌiyagu,

ma hesi geya yaloiloina ꞌabehega tologwaliyedi ma tobwatobwa ꞌana tohamwao ma toyagahao ma tolonabwasuwao walogwahatedi, weyahina baleꞌu bewa ꞌoina taudi gidemusa baibaiwa hedade, geya sawasawahida taꞌebesinedi.

Ma bewa tuwa ꞌigu loina ꞌoimiya gide, ꞌeguma taiya ꞌihekalesiya ma ꞌilogwali, ꞌeguma tomata tobwatobwa, bo tolonabwasuwa, bo toheliya, bo tonuma bwasi waiwai, bo toyagaha, geyaꞌabwa waꞌahwa ꞌiyaꞌiyaguwe bo nuwana mahetemiu waꞌai.
Ta ꞌigu ꞌebeloina tohekalesiyaomo ꞌoidiya, ma geyaꞌabwa hali boda ꞌoidiya.
Weyahina taudi muliyetega Yehoba ꞌiloinaedi, ma hesi tologwaliina ꞌaigeda ꞌomi ꞌimi boda, ꞌoinega ꞌilobwaineya ma waloinae, ma ꞌoimiyega wapaꞌi.
